name: Image Editor
author: FryPDF Team
description: Professional layered design and photo editing studio: modular docking workspace, inpainting Remove tool, Curves, Liquify, Shadows/Highlights, Black & White adjustments, text warp, Grd/Abr/Patterns and FITS/PCX/KRA codecs, OpenType typography, layers panel, and template gallery.
releaseNotes: Adds modular dock workspace layout with tab grouping, edge splitting, and multi-zone docking; restores palette panels (Brushes, Actions, Adjustments, Gradients, Swatches, Navigator, Info, Channels, Paths); expands raster, vector, and codec engines.
